events.title_zh: BIS 澄清先进计算产品的既有出口许可要求
events.title_en: BIS clarifies existing export-license requirements for advanced computing items
facts_zh: BIS 的 5 月 31 日指引说明，向总部或最终母公司位于 Country Group D:5 或澳门的实体出口先进计算产品需要许可，即使实体位于其他地区。
指引说明该许可要求始于 2023 年；合规的数据中心运营者无须仅因这份指引停止产品的既有使用、存放或维护。
facts_en: The May 31 BIS guidance says a license is required for exports of advanced computing items to entities headquartered, or ultimately parented, in Country Group D:5 or Macau, even if located elsewhere.
The guidance says the license requirement originated in 2023 and that compliant data-center operators need not stop existing use, storage or servicing solely because of the guidance.

facts_zh: CoreWeave 的间接子公司 8 月 7 日签订 26 亿美元延迟提款定期贷款协议；公司 8 月 10 日公告贷款已关闭，主要用途是客户合同相关 GPU 服务器与基础设施资本开支。
SEC 文件规定，SOFR 贷款的年利率为 Term SOFR 加 5.50 个百分点利差；另有基准利率贷款及未提款费用口径，5.50% 不是总融资利率。
facts_en: A CoreWeave subsidiary entered a $2.6 billion delayed-draw term-loan agreement on August 7; the company announced its closing on August 10, primarily for GPU-server and infrastructure capex tied to customer contracts.
The SEC filing sets the annual rate on SOFR loans at Term SOFR plus a 5.50-percentage-point margin; base-rate loans and undrawn fees have separate terms, so 5.50% is not the all-in borrowing rate.
